title: Pyne Pod 2in1 Fresh Mint Prefilled Vape Pods - Pod Salt Edition
description: This Fresh Mint Pod Pack for the Pyne Pod 2-in-1 Kit delivers a crisp and cooling mint profile that’s clean and smooth from the first puff to the last. The flavour balances gentle sweetness with a crisp, refreshing mint with a smooth and balanced chill.. Each pod contains 2ml of 20mg nicotine salt e-liquid and is made for the Pyne Pod 2-in-1 device. Pods attach securely via a magnetic connection and are fully compatible with the twist-activated dual-pod system. With two pods per pack, Fresh Mint is a versatile option that complements both fruity and ice-based flavours for a well-rounded vape experience.
